meta.name: Uttoron
meta.description:
Uttoron brings forward the brutal truth of society through the eyes of a woman, whose entire world turns upside down after the leak of an MMS.

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

videos.title: Madhuchandrima
videos.overview: After a lovely honeymoon in Goa, Parna comes home with her husband, Abhi. Her charming husband and caring family make her feel grateful for this life.

videos.title: Aguner Phulki
videos.overview: Unbeknown to Parna, the MMS reaches all of her near and dear ones and threatens to shatter her beautiful life.

videos.title: Noshto Neer
videos.overview: Abhi refuses to talk to an emotionally devastated Parna. Nilarko, Abhi's brother, discusses the matter with a friend who is in the police and tries to find a solution.

videos.title: Bohishkar
videos.overview: Parna's students and colleagues humiliate her. She tries to take refuge in her parents' house.

videos.title: Samporko
videos.overview: Abhi asks Parna for a divorce. Someone from Parna's past reaches out to her.

videos.title: Sadharon Meye
videos.overview: Nilarko and Tanaya try to fix their problems. Nilarko's words give Parna the strength to face the world outside home.

videos.title: Bojhapora
videos.overview: Parna reveals the truth in the police station and demands to file a defamation suit against the entire system. What does the future hold for her?
